industry.title: Build Plans
industry.deleteConfirm: Delete this build plan? This can't be undone.
industry.emptyHint: Create a plan to price out a manufacturing job.
industry.selectHint: Select a build plan, or create one.
industry.blueprintMissing: This plan's blueprint isn't in the current SDE snapshot.
industry.meTooltip: Material Efficiency: reduces material waste per run (0-10, higher wastes less).
industry.teTooltip: Time Efficiency: reduces job duration (0-20, higher is faster).
industry.facilityTaxTooltip: Structure owner's cut of the job fee, set per-structure by its owner.
industry.eivTooltip: Estimated Item Value: the SCC's reference price for the materials consumed, used to calculate job fees.
industry.costIndexFeeTooltip: Part of the job fee driven by system manufacturing activity: EIV × this system's cost index.
industry.sccSurchargeTooltip: Fixed 4% surcharge on the job's EIV, paid to the Secure Commerce Commission.
industry.costIndexTooltip: This solar system's system cost index: the manufacturing activity level that drives the job's cost-index fee. Tied to the trade hub above, not a separate setting.
industry.iskPerHourTooltip: Profit divided by build time (job-slot occupancy time, not wall-clock wait) — an hourly-rate comparison across builds.
industry.pricesUnavailableHint: Reconnect to fetch job cost, profit, and the build-vs-buy verdict. Materials and time above don't need it.
industry.unpricedMaterialsWarning: {{count}} material(s) have no hub price; totals below are underestimated.
industry.productUnpriced: {{name}} has no hub sell price; no build-vs-buy verdict.
industry.verdictUnknown: Not enough price data for a build-vs-buy verdict.
